newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks rise further on small rate cut.
newsitem.headline: French stocks rise further on small rate cut.

text.p: French shares extended their gains after the Bank of France said it was cutting its intervention rate to 3.10 percent from 3.15 percent.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 32.50 points or 1.32 percent at 2,497.43 at 1230 GMT while the CAC-40 futures contract was up at 2,495 from 2,465 on Wednesday's close.
Before the cut the CAC-40 was up 1.2 percent at 2,494.47.
